title: OOFEM input-deck eval
summary: Can a model write a native OOFEM input deck that reproduces a paper's curves? The oofem job's question, without the Python bindings: the model hands in model.in (or make_deck.py that writes it) and postprocess.py, the harness runs the oofem executable between them, and the curves are scored against the paper's digitized data. Same cases, curve contract and scorer as the oofem job, so the two compare. The default one-shot arm gets one call; the agent arm (--agent) can read the OOFEM source and test decks, run spike decks and validate before submitting.

groups.label: one-shot arm (default)
groups.detail: Used when --agent is not given. One call, no feedback of any kind: the candidate runs once as written.

groups.label: agent arm
groups.detail: A tool loop that runs until the model submits a validated candidate or a budget runs out. The full transcript is kept, so every step can be audited.

groups.label: agent tools
groups.detail: Reads are confined to the OOFEM tree and the workdir; writes to the workdir.

groups.label: candidate pipeline
groups.detail: What both arms execute, in one directory, under one --run-timeout: generate, solve, postprocess. worker/jobs/oofem-native/pipeline.py.

nodes.label: Dataset
nodes.detail: Paper text, paper PDF and scope.md per case. Built automatically if missing.

nodes.label: Reference curves
nodes.detail: The (file, column) curves a case must reproduce; a copy of the oofem job's curves.py. Cases without reference curves are skipped before any call.

nodes.label: OOFEM source + decks
nodes.detail: The record keywords compiled into this build (generated from the source, filtered by liboofem.so's symbols), a hand-written deck primer, and OOFEM's own test decks as worked examples. The agent arm can also read the C++ source and all ~430 test decks.

nodes.label: Model roster
nodes.detail: Model ids, token limits, timeouts, prices, and whether a model accepts images.

nodes.label: oofem runs a smoke deck
nodes.detail: OOFEM_BIN solves a two-node truss deck. Checked before any call; skipped by --dry-run.

nodes.label: Build prompt
nodes.detail: Scope, paper text (cut at --max-paper-chars), the curve contract, the deck primer, the record list, two worked decks, and the time limit the pipeline must fit.

nodes.label: Write candidate
nodes.detail: One chat completion. The reply must contain the candidate files as fenced blocks named by their info string.

nodes.label: Extract files
nodes.detail: Blocks tagged model.in, make_deck.py, postprocess.py. postprocess.py and one of the other two are required and the Python must parse; otherwise the outcome is unparseable and nothing runs.

nodes.label: Static gate
nodes.detail: Refuses Python that imports oofempy or oofem (this job is about the deck) or subprocess, socket, urllib and similar. Outcome rejected.

nodes.label: make_deck.py
nodes.detail: Runs first when present and must write model.in. Outcomes gen_crashed, no_deck.

nodes.label: oofem -f model.in
nodes.detail: The harness runs the executable; the candidate never does. A nonzero exit is deck_error, reported with OOFEM's own 'Error exception' line. Unread-keyword warnings are recorded.

nodes.label: postprocess.py
nodes.detail: Reads the files the deck's export modules wrote and writes results.csv and plot.png. Outcomes post_crashed, no_output.

nodes.label: System prompt + workdir
nodes.detail: Scope, curve contract, deck primer, record list, turn budget. The paper goes into work/ as paper.txt and paper.pdf, not into the prompt.

nodes.label: Agent turn
nodes.detail: One completion per turn with tool calls; a copy of the oofem job's loop. Token use is added up across turns and reported next to the score.

nodes.label: Turn budget + nudges
nodes.detail: A first candidate is due after a third of --max-turns, insisted on at half. After --max-turns, --finalization-turns remain for repair, validation and submit only. Stops on submit, budget, more than 3 turns without a tool call, degenerate output, or a persistent API error.

nodes.label: Read OOFEM source
nodes.detail: list_dir, read_file, grep, inspect_record (a record's own and inherited attribute keywords, its section from OOFEM's manuals, plus test-deck usage), search_manual (manual sections by topic, manual.py).

nodes.label: Read paper
nodes.detail: read_paper_page for text. view_paper_page renders the page as an image, only for models marked vision.

nodes.label: run_oofem
nodes.detail: The executable on a spike deck in the workdir, with error lines, warnings and written files reported. Capped by --spike-timeout.

nodes.label: run_python
nodes.detail: Tests a mesh generator or an output parser. Refuses oofempy / oofem imports. Capped by --spike-timeout.

nodes.label: write_file
nodes.detail: Writing a candidate file marks the candidate as not validated.

nodes.label: run_candidate
nodes.detail: Runs the full pipeline from a clean staging directory and checks that results.csv holds the contract's curve ids. Capped by --run-timeout.

nodes.label: submit
nodes.detail: Accepted only if these exact candidate files passed run_candidate. An edit after that makes the submission invalid again.

nodes.label: results.csv + plot
nodes.detail: Long format, curve,x,y. postprocess.py must also plot the result over the reference.

nodes.label: Score curves
nodes.detail: A copy of the oofem job's scorer: score = coverage × max(0, 1 − nrmse). A missing curve scores 0.

nodes.label: run.json
nodes.detail: Per call: mode, outcome, failed stage, curve scores, turns, tokens, cost, oofem warnings, and whether oofem exited 0 and wrote files (solver_evidence).

edges.when: the required blocks are present and parse

edges.carries: reference/ copied into the run directory for the overlay plot

edges.label: nudges + stop
edges.carries: 'the first candidate is due now', 'finalization only: N turns remain', and the stop decision
per-stage status, oofem errors and warnings, missing curve ids, output tails
only the contract outputs, copied back
